postData.title: Contributing to Next.js: What I Learned
postData.contentHtml:
My first real open-source contribution came out of a class assignment that asked me to read a large codebase and find something to fix. I ended up going much deeper than expected.

Finding the Bug

The issue was straightforward to reproduce: in standalone mode, NextResponse.rewrite() from middleware produced a 307 redirect instead of being processed internally.

The dev server worked fine. Production deployments hit an infinite redirect loop.

The root cause turned out to be in resolve-routes.ts.

The Fix

One word: else.

Changing the second block from a standalone if to else if made the location block mutually exclusive with the rewrite block.

// Before
if (middlewareHeaders['x-middleware-rewrite']) {
  // ...
}

if (middlewareHeaders['location']) {
  // ...
}

// After
if (middlewareHeaders['x-middleware-rewrite']) {
  // ...
} else if (middlewareHeaders['location']) {
  // ...
}
